sampled.gdp_deflator_growth: triangular(low, central, high) from parameters.yaml macro inputs (C2)
sampled.tfp_growth: triangular(low, central, high) from parameters.yaml macro inputs (C2)
sampled.human_capital_growth: triangular(low, central, high) from parameters.yaml macro inputs (C2)
sampled.investment_rate: triangular(low, central, high) from parameters.yaml macro inputs (C2)
sampled.okun_coefficient: triangular(low, central, high) from parameters.yaml macro inputs (C2)
sampled.pension_gdp_per_worker_weight: uniform(low, high), snapped to a 0.025 grid
sampled.leakage_share: uniform(low, high) from governance.leakage_share_of_spending (cancels in scenario-vs-S0 comparisons; drives the leakage_halved sensitivity)

fixed.point_inputs: every macro input with low = central = high (initial debt, revenue/GDP, capital share, K/Y, depreciation, GDP anchors)

external: C6 block bootstrap (3-year blocks) of joint observed 2006-2024 terms-of-trade and BRL/USD changes, same path for every scenario in a draw; separate random stream [seed, 1]
choices: triangular sampling for ranges is a modelling choice (fiscal_multipliers_brazil.sampling_rule), not a sourced distribution
parameters are sampled independently: no sourced correlations
persistence (transitory/persistent) is reported as a dimension, not sampled
percentiles describe parameter uncertainty only, not forecast error or external shocks
